title.quote: Debiasing Counterfactuals In the Presence of Spurious Correlations

extractions.description: This paper presents a training framework that integrates debiasing classifiers with counterfactual image generation to unveil generalizable imaging markers, reducing reliance on spurious correlations in medical imaging classification tasks. A novel metric, Spurious Correlation Latching Score (SCLS), is introduced to measure classifier reliance on spurious correlations.
